maddeler.e:
تستوقفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْقِفُوا (tastawqifū) /tas.taw.qi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
# تُسْتَوْقَفُوا (tustawqafū) /tus.taw.qa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَفَ (istawqafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
